audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits the 54.45% win rate: Syndra's 7s Q out-cycles Lux's 10s Q / 10-8s E, her R needs no setup while Lux's whole combo keys off landing Light Binding, and E stun answers any step-up.

Both layers read Syndra 7/7, matching the packet levelChart and favoured rating; whys are stage-specific and kit-grounded (cooldown edge early, setup-free R at 6, one-shot without root late). No chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number; Lux called he/his in eight fields; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Verified from kits: Light Binding is a flat 10s at 1175 range, blockable by minions and projectile-class walls; Lucent Singularity 10-8s reveals stealth and zones; Final Spark is only 60/50/40s at 3340 range — a real snipe threat at low HP; Prismatic Barrier shields change all-in maths; her passive is an auto-attack proc, so hugging melee range of Lux costs extra. Syndra E (15s) knocks her back — Lux has no dash to re-enter.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in, pronouns corrected, bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.
